items.prompt: parameter WIDTH = 8 at the module boundary…
choices: Can be overridden per instance with #(.WIDTH(n))
Can never change from its default
Is the same as a wire
items.explain: parameter is the public, overridable compile-time knob.

items.prompt: localparam DEPTH = WIDTH * 2 is meant for…
choices: Derived constants that should not be overridden from outside
Runtime variables that change every cycle
items.explain: localparam stays inside the module; it tracks parameters without exposing another override point.

choices: Sets WIDTH to 4 for that instance; derived localparams recompute
items.explain: Instance parameter overrides apply at elaboration; localparams derived from WIDTH update too.

items.prompt: #(.DEPTH(99)) is inappropriate when DEPTH is declared as localparam.
items.explain: localparam cannot be overridden from outside; DEPTH must stay derived inside the module.
